name: GET /api/admin/metrics/overview - Portal dashboard metrics
description: Aggregate counts backing the admin dashboard: accounts by access status, by plan, by subscription status, new accounts this month and documents sent this month. Computed with SQL GROUP BY rather than by fetching rows, so it stays cheap as the platform grows. Read-only, so no step-up elevation required.

errorCases.when: The caller is authenticated but is not a platform_admin (a tenant-level admin is refused here)

errorCases.message: Platform administrator access has been revoked
errorCases.when: The admin's own access_status is suspended or revoked
